answer: Cosignatures are collected in karst, verified in lantern, and timber names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 50 submissions per epoch. That is 931 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
